structural_checks: One graph per metric plus source observation age
Unique panel IDs and non-overlapping grid
All six scope/provenance filters in every measurement query
Missing series are not replaced with zero

data_integrity: Legacy evidence canonical hashes unchanged when series absent
Optional samples persist through SQLite export/import with manifest
Scalar evaluator verdict does not depend on chart samples
Frozen report graphs omit mismatched input hashes
browser_harness: Navigation is blocked by the execution environment. Tests use DOM injection. The metrics preview harness supplies SHA-256 for its insecure about:blank page. Live UI API requests are bridged to a real loopback HTTP server; served script/style hashes are enforced via meta CSP. Native browser navigation, fetch/CORS and CSP connect-src are not tested.
not_verified: No real AWS account or Docker/Podman/Kubernetes runtime connected
No CloudWatch or Prometheus telemetry queried
No Grafana server import, provisioning or PromQL execution
No container image built or started
No fault injection or production-readiness certification
reproduction: Install requirements-dev.txt; run python build_ui.py; execute the commands above. Browser tests require Chromium. Generated UI, schema, demo bundle and Grafana JSON are build outputs.
